note: Vincent joined a tenth of a second after the room opened and stayed for the whole forty-nine minutes, so leg time is room time. Two stretches come out. 9:49 to 10:38 is an echo-troubleshooting loop — 'are you hearing the feedback too', try muting, 'could you ask the question again' — which the first hand edit read past twice and the auto cutter found. 18:40 to 19:34 is Mira asking the same question three ways while Vincent waits. The first version of this edit cut from 17:36, which ran straight through the middle of Patrick's question about prevention and left Vincent answering something the audience never heard him asked. The whole question is now in, and the cut starts after it. Sept 20: Vincent approved by email with two asks. The first cut now starts at his first answer's question, 'where are you calling from', so Mira's line about hearing and approving the finished episode is gone. The third cut now starts at 'So I don't have a great answer', after his aside about getting back to Mira's other question, which pointed at a question that is no longer in the episode. Oct 7: rebuilt on Vincent's own browser recording, which reached R2 whole but was never finalized by his page. This run's per-speaker tracks are not on the room's clock (Patrick's second leg starts nineteen minutes in and Mira's track wanders by seconds), so the cut still comes from his leg's stereo recording, with the left side swapped: leg_local_v2.flac is his take placed phrase by phrase on the room's clock and gated by his echo-cancelled call leg. He had no headphones and his speakers were as loud in the take as he was, so wherever Mira or Patrick was talking (51 seconds of overlaps and turn edges) the call leg stands in for his take. The right side is that recording's own (the room as he heard it), already de-clicked and de-hissed so the assembler does not have to. Same cuts, same times.
